title: Annual General Meeting - Sept 20
body: All residents are invited to the AGM in the clubhouse at 6 PM to discuss the annual budget and upcoming maintenance work.

title: Water Supply Interruption
body: Water supply will be interrupted on Sept 15 from 10 AM to 2 PM for overhead tank cleaning.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi Celebration
body: Join us for the Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at the community hall on Sept 14 from 6 PM. Snacks and refreshments will be provided.

title: Maintenance Bill Due Reminder
body: Monthly maintenance dues for September are due by Sept 10. Please pay via the society office to avoid late fees.
